neighbours.label: 'both' in 'both sides' and Japanese 両- compounds (両親, 両方, 両側): reference to the two sides or members of a pair, vs 'one side' and other counts
fire: The fabric is printed on both sides, so it can be worn either way.
Trees were planted along both sides of the new avenue.
道路の両側に桜の木が並んでいます。
We should listen to both sides of the story before deciding.
彼は両方の意見を聞いてから決めました。
Apply glue to both sides of the board and press them together.
週末は両親の家に帰ります。
The river has steep banks on both sides near the old mill.
quiet: The fabric is printed on one side, so it can only be worn one way.
Trees were planted along the north side of the new avenue.
道路の片側に桜の木が並んでいます。
We should listen to the whole story before deciding.
彼は先生の意見を聞いてから決めました。
Apply glue to the edge of the board and press them together.
週末は祖母の家に帰ります。
The river has a steep bank on the left near the old mill.

predictions: 'both' in 'both sides of' and 両 in 両親/両側/両方 reach 0.2-0.4; 'one side', 'each side' and single-member words stay under 0.05. 'both hands'/'Both parents' were weak in the probe, so the median may miss.
